info.about.title: About Lao Epic
info.about.body:
Lao Epic connects travelers with authentic experiences across Laos — from community tours to nature adventures.

We work with local providers and guides so your trip supports villages and preserves culture.

This app is part of our thesis project to make booking tours in Laos simple and trustworthy.

Booking: Choose a package, pick a departure date, add travelers, then pay online or pay later before the deadline.

Payment: After checkout you are redirected to our secure payment partner. Return to the app to see payment status.

Account: Sign in with email or Google. Update your profile under Account settings.

help.subtitle: Find answers about booking, payment, and your account — or contact our team.

help.step1_desc: Open Package, pick a tour, and select your travel date.
help.step2_desc: Fill in contact details and travelers, then review your invoice.
help.step3_desc: Complete payment via PhaJay (BCEL QR or card). Check status in My bookings.
help.contact_subtitle: We typically reply within 1–2 business days.
help.faq.b1_q: How do I book a tour?
help.faq.b1_a: Browse Package, open a tour you like, choose a departure date, enter contact and traveler details, then confirm. You will receive a booking invoice before payment.
help.faq.b2_q: Can I cancel or get a refund?
help.faq.b2_a: Open My Bookings or your invoice page. Unpaid bookings can be cancelled instantly. Paid or confirmed bookings require a cancellation request — staff must approve. Refunds are not automatic through the payment gateway; any repayment is agreed with the operator separately.
help.faq.b3_q: Where can I see my bookings?
help.faq.b3_a: After logging in, open My bookings from your profile menu or go to /my-bookings to see status, dates, and invoices.
help.faq.p1_a: We use PhaJay payment gateway — BCEL QR and card/other options on the secure payment page after you review your invoice.
help.faq.p2_q: I paid but the page says "Invoice already paid"
help.faq.p2_a: Your payment was likely recorded already. Open My bookings to check status. Do not pay the same invoice twice. Contact us if status is still unpaid after 24 hours.
help.faq.p3_q: Can I get a receipt or invoice copy?
help.faq.p3_a: Yes. From My bookings, open your booking and use View invoice. Keep the invoice number for support requests.
help.faq.a1_q: Do I need an account to book?
help.faq.a1_a: Yes. Log in or register before confirming a booking so we can link your reservation and send updates.
help.faq.a2_q: How do I update my profile or password?
help.faq.a2_a: Go to Settings from your profile menu. You can change your name, phone, photo, and password there.
